title: NSF quantum-materials phrase-search portfolio

boundary.dateField: award start date, not original award/amendment date
boundary.APITextScope: keyword searches all available award data; local exact-match filter restricts inclusion to title or abstract

amountMeaning: Sum of current cumulative NSF obligations for distinct retained awards; covers all relevance classes, not a quantum-materials-only total.
coverageLimitations: Complete retrieval within these exact phrase and project-start-date boundaries only; not a census of all NSF quantum-materials funding.
Awards about superconductors, topology, spin systems, nanomaterials or related fields that never use these phrases are not captured.
Quantum-matter search also retrieves cold atoms, simulators, gravity and other non-solid settings. These are not automatically quantum materials.
Rule-assisted scope labels are transparent screening labels, not a validated scientific taxonomy. Needs-review records are excluded from quantum-materials-only views.
Some whole-center and shared-instrument awards include multiple topics. No topic-level share of their obligations is inferred.

Current obligations include amendments; dates and amounts may change after this snapshot. An explicitly reported zero is retained as zero with its conflicting historical fiscal-year lines and a source-anomaly note. Missing/non-finite values are null; they are never inferred to be zero.
Official API keyword search operates beyond title/abstract; the local title/abstract check excludes one nonmatching hit.
NSF fundsObligatedAmt is not necessarily identical to award ceiling, expenditures, annual payments, or a recipient university budget.
PI names establish award-team associations, not lab membership or a lab funding allocation.

classificationMethod.method: Conservative deterministic rules, retained prior source-specific classifications for existing atlas records, and targeted manual abstract screening of 10 ambiguous records.
classificationMethod.qmOnlyRule: scopeType quantum-materials only; needs-review, mixed-materials, broader-qis, and synthetic-quantum-systems excluded.
classificationMethod.typeRule: Title-based grouped grant types are distinct from the official NSF fundProgramName and transType fields.

excluded.awardTitle: Theoretical Studies of Ultrafast Electron Dynamics in Molecules Interacting with Intense Laser Pulses
excluded.reason: API keyword hit has no exact quantum material(s) or quantum matter phrase in returned title/abstract
